recommendations.action: Run CI on this branch and record the results at the commit under trace. Story 1 AC-4 (`integrated-check` passes) and story 5's verify (the eval check and `integrated-check` pass, `eval/baseline.json` unchanged, import-linter keeps every contract) are the only R2 contributors below FULL, so they are what holds P0 at 50%. Their static evidence is complete; what is missing is a recorded run. The live results must carry the commit the trace reads (`git rev-parse HEAD`), so record them before committing the trace outputs.

Record story 3 AC-4 (ruff, pyright, lint-imports and unit pytest pass) and AC-5 (`eval / deploy` is a required check) the same way. Branch protection on main already lists `checks`, `integrated-check / deploy` and `eval / deploy` as required contexts (read with `gh api repos/Dillon-Based/ticketscope/branches/main/protection`), which is the observation AC-5 needs. These hold R3 at PARTIAL, a P1 row.
Story 5 is also a contributor to R3 and R4, so its recorded result lifts those rows to FULL together with R2.
